translations.web: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.
translations.bsb: The sins of some men are obvious, going ahead of them to judgment; but the sins of others do not surface until later.
translations.kjv: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
translations.asv: Some men's sins are evident, going before unto judgment; and some men also they follow after.
